rationale: The full relationship couples RAG and fine-tuning to a deployed PostgreSQL-backed application. No approved same-event evidence supports that bundle; the pipeline does not borrow a GCP database connector, generic model-loading code or another project to satisfy it. All 91 candidate attempts are independently rejected by deterministic eligibility/identity/capability gates within the bounded pool, with no forced bullet. Safe refusal is the expected unsupported-conjunction result.

fallback_pool.provenance_policy: Canonical source/hash/scope verified; quote-level attempts; every candidate independently licensed
